Methods

GetProfile(string)

Generates a profile of k-length substrings (shingles) from the specified string, along with their frequency of occurrence.

public Dictionary<string, int> GetProfile(string s)

Parameters

s string

The input string from which to generate the shingle profile. Cannot be null.

Returns

Dictionary<string, int>

A dictionary where the keys are k-length substrings (shingles) extracted from the input string, and the values are the number of times each shingle appears.

Remarks

This method processes the input string by normalizing spaces and then extracting overlapping substrings of length k. The resulting dictionary provides a frequency count for each unique shingle.
